implemented.details: A grouped reference keeps its selected item/metadata variant. Drilldown and history change only the insert, retaining the same research entry and text page. Reference item matching ignores count and NBT, exactly as 1.12.2 ItemStack.func_77969_a; therefore differently colored item IDs remain distinct while aspect-only NBT variants choose the first item+metadata match. Blueprint display fallback blocks do not create item references.

Displayed variants and bookmark outputs obey each recipe own research gate, including @stage and &&; reference lookup does not require completed owner research. Lookup scans stage recipes only, not addenda. A locked direct match returns UNKNOWN and stops before alternative recipes; a group skips locked members as in original findRecipePage.

The original nested split/paragraph/image queue order is preserved. Non-fitting images wait while later text can fill the column; empty paragraph checkpoints also drain the queue after automatic page transitions. Trailing empty tokens dropped by the original Java split are handled as original, not promoted into extra images/pages. Current source-parity evidence is the 600-case BookDocumentParityTest.
